name: Assemble the Entmoot
oracle_text:
Creatures you control have reach.
Sacrifice this enchantment: Create three tapped X/X green Treefolk creature tokens, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn. Put a reach counter on each of them.
blocked_sentences: Sacrifice this enchantment: Create three tapped X/X green Treefolk creature tokens, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn. Put a reach counter on each of them.

needs.what: a 0/0 green Treefolk creature token (X/X, sized by create_token's power/toughness from life_gained_this_turn)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has 0/0 green Hydra, Ooze and Dinosaur Beast tokens but no Treefolk; the token list is closed and a different creature type is a different token. create_token's tapped/power/toughness/counters options and the life_gained_this_turn value would otherwise cover the sentence, provided a reach counter grants reach as a keyword counter
